title: Lazy-load all images within Admin Dashboard using existing LazyImage

requirements.summary: Replace Admin Dashboard image rendering with the existing LazyImage component so images load only when near/in viewport (or eagerly when marked high priority), with stable placeholders to avoid layout shift.
acceptanceCriteria: All `` usages within Admin Dashboard-related components are replaced with `LazyImage` where applicable (e.g., report photos, proof photos, representative photos, logo previews, and any other images shown in admin flows).
Images only start downloading when they are near/inside the viewport (or immediately when marked as high priority).
Above-the-fold/critical images (e.g., images visible immediately in an opened modal or a primary preview) use `priority="high"` so they load eagerly when needed.
While an image is loading, a non-jarring placeholder/skeleton is visible and the layout does not shift significantly.

file_operations.description: Audit all AdminDashboard tab content (volunteers, NGO/NPO, pending edits, etc.) for any `` usage and replace with the existing `LazyImage` component; apply `priority="high"` to images that are immediately visible when a modal/detail panel opens. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Replace all report-related `` elements (table/card thumbnails, edit previews, proof photos, leader photos, etc.) with `LazyImage`; ensure placeholders have explicit/stable dimensions (e.g., fixed w/h classes) to prevent layout shift; use `priority="high"` for images that appear immediately in an opened modal. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Replace all `` elements (report photo, proof photo, MLA/PM/CM/MP headshots, any full-size modal images) with `LazyImage`; use `priority="high"` for the primary image shown in any modal upon open and keep stable container sizing for non-jarring skeletons. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Replace all representative photo `` usages (lists/cards, edit form previews, and photo modal rendering) with `LazyImage`; ensure list views are lazy (default/low) and modal images use `priority="high"`; keep fixed aspect/size wrappers to avoid layout shift. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Replace all logo preview `` usages (new-logo preview block and preview modal image) with `LazyImage`; use `priority="high"` inside the preview modal and maintain stable preview dimensions for skeleton/placeholder rendering. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Harden LazyImage behavior for admin use: ensure placeholder sizing is stable (no unexpected layout shifts) and that className/styling is applied consistently between wrapper and image; keep IntersectionObserver-based lazy behavior and eager loading for `priority="high"`. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Ensure lazy loading is correctly applied on image-heavy admin surfaces (Reports, Directory, and Content/Logo management), including eager loading for modal previews.
acceptanceCriteria: Admin Reports UI: photos shown in lists/cards and any expanded/edit views use lazy loading and show placeholders until loaded.
Admin Directory UI: representative photos use lazy loading in lists/cards, and any photo modal loads the image eagerly when opened (priority high).
Admin Content Management UI: logo preview `` elements use lazy loading; the preview modal loads its image eagerly when opened (priority high).

file_operations.description: Implement/verify lazy behavior specifically for the Reports management surface: thumbnails in tables/cards use `LazyImage` with default (low) priority; expanded/edit sections keep placeholders and do not trigger eager downloads; full-size preview modals render with `LazyImage priority="high"`. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Implement/verify lazy behavior for the Reports detail surface: inline images lazy-load with placeholders; when opening proof/full-photo modals, render the modal image with `LazyImage priority="high"` so it loads immediately upon modal open. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Implement/verify lazy behavior for Directory representative photos: list/card photos use `LazyImage` (low) with stable sizing; the photo modal swaps to `LazyImage priority="high"` to load immediately when opened. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Implement/verify lazy behavior for Content/Logo management previews: inline preview uses `LazyImage` (low) with stable dimensions; preview modal uses `LazyImage priority="high"` to load immediately when opened. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
